name: Multi-Docks
author: qempexe
description: Up to 12 configurable docks: pinned apps, drag to reorder, live window previews, right-click menus, auto-hide with eight effects, reserved space, theme or monochrome colors, and a body of your choice: 32 kinds of ends, 30 surfaces, 22 lines, 18 ornaments, shadows, and 16 ready made looks.
